QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] Chasing Twilight
QuestInfo.0: The people of Perion want proof that their nightmare was fabricated. Listen to #bAthena Pierce#k.
QuestInfo.1: Your efforts to help the people of Perion will require you to enter the Temple of Time, go through the Gate to the Future, and travel to #bTwilight Perion#k to find Christopher.
QuestInfo.2: Talk to Christopher, a resident of Twilight Perion.

no.0: Are you busy? Just come back whenever you have the... time.

1.0: *huff-puff* M-my heart's gonna give out at this rate. Hm? Who are you?

yes.0: Hold on, let me catch my breath.

npc.0: Who is the enemy sending these nightmares to Maple World...?
